full_text_zh:
[P1] 大头鱼上学记
[美] 德博拉·戴森/文
[美] 丹·汉纳/图
孙慧阳/译

[P2] 很久很久以前，
大头鱼还很小的时候，
他第一次去上学。

带着爸爸妈妈亲吻的余温，
带着对这一天的期盼，
大头鱼冲进了学校……
紧接着他迷路了。

深海摇摆鱼小学

[P3] 在它周围游动的大鱼们，很清楚
自己要去哪儿，他们找到储物柜，
认准班级，飞快地一闪而入。

[P4] 大头鱼落在了后面，笑容渐渐从他脸上消失，最后他停在一间教室门边，羞怯地朝里面望去。

[P5] 这个班正在练习书写，大多数同学都会写。

[P6] 大头鱼试着写出自己的名字，但是他就是写不好。

[P7] 大头鱼觉得一团糟，他皱起眉头，“噗噜噗噜”吹着气，“啪嗒”一声扔下铅笔，数了数自己遇到的麻烦：

[P8] 麻烦一：我不聪明！
麻烦二：我永远也学不会！
麻烦三：我适应不了！
还有麻烦四：还是算了吧！

[P9] 大头鱼皱着眉头，沿着长长的走廊向前游。

[P10] 它透过另一间教室的门，
小心翼翼地朝里面望去。

[P11] 这个班正在练习画形状，
大多数同学都会画。

[P12] 大头鱼试着画菱形……
但是他就是画不好。

[P13] 大头鱼觉得一团糟，他皱起眉，“噗噜噗噜”吹着气，“啪嗒”一声扔下铅笔，数了数自己遇到的麻烦：

[P14] 麻烦一：我不聪明！
麻烦二：我永远也学不会！
还有麻烦四：还是算了吧！
麻烦三：我适应不了！

[P15] 游泳队
报名吧！
争当跳水明星！
大头鱼愁容满面，
沿着过道越飘越低。
男生
女生

[P16] 直到她又来到一间教室的门前——
也许这儿才是他应该待的地方。

[P17] 这个班正在练习算术，大多数同学都会算。

[P18] 大头鱼试着列竖式算除法……
但他就是不会列。

[P19] 大头鱼觉得一团糟，他皱起眉头，“噗噜噗噜”吹着气，“啪嗒”一声扔下铅笔，数了数自己遇到的麻烦：

[P20] 麻烦一：我不聪明！
麻烦二：我永远也学不会！
还有第四……
麻烦三：我适应不了！

[P21] “算了吧！”
他朝学校外匆匆游去 “天哪，
我受够了！上学就是自讨苦
吃，我可不想待在这儿！”

[P22] 就在这时，传来了一个温柔、友善的声音：
“不用着急！还没有开始学呢，不会也没关系！
适合你的班级正在等着你去呢——
我是休伊特老师，我是来帮助你学习的。我知道你能行！"

[P23] “你是聪明的小鱼。多多练习，你就能学会。小家伙，你会适应这里的——一定要记住哦！"

[P24] 大头鱼同学跟着休伊特老师嗖嗖地向前游，身边水花四溅。他们一直游到一扇挂着牌子的门前，牌子上写着“新生班”。

[P25] 休伊特老师跟大家打招呼：“早上好！很高兴在这里见到你们。我们会一起度过令人期待的一年！
真相一：你们很聪明。
真相二：你们能学会！
真相三：你们在一起。
还有第四：一定要记住！”

[P26] 开始上课了，休伊特老师带领大家一起学。
同学们先听，再试着去做……
每一位同学都做得很好！

[P27] 大头鱼露出了笑容。“再见啦，哭丧脸！再也没有疑神疑鬼的小担心！再也没有糟糕透顶的大麻烦！"

[P28] 大头鱼和小朋友们一起畅游，休伊特老师陪伴在他身边，同学和老师一起信心百倍，充满自豪的欢呼：

[P29] 真相一：我们很聪明。
真相二：我们能学会。
真相三：我们在一起。

[P30] “我们一定会牢记！”
学前班联欢会
休伊特老师班级
full_text_en:
[P1] The Big-Headed Fish Goes to School
[US] Deborah Diesen / Text
[US] Dan Hanna / Illustrations
Sun Huiyang / Translator

[P2] Long, long ago,
when Big-Head Fish was still very small,
he went to school for the first time.

With the lingering warmth of his parents' kisses,
and full of anticipation for the day,
Big-Head Fish rushed into school……
Then, he got lost.

Deep-Sea Swinging Fish Elementary School

[P3] The big fish swimming around it clearly knew
where they were going. They found their lockers,
identified their classes, and darted in quickly.

[P4] Big-Head Fish fell behind, the smile gradually fading from his face. Finally, he stopped by a classroom door, shyly looking inside.

[P5] This class is practicing writing. Most students can write.

[P6] Big-Head Fish tried to write his own name, but he just couldn't do it well.

[P7] Big-Head Fish felt like a mess. He frowned, puffed out his cheeks with a 'puff-puff' sound, and 'clunk' dropped his pencil, counting up all the troubles he'd encountered:

[P8] Problem One: I'm not smart!
Problem Two: I'll never learn it!
Problem Three: I can't adapt!
And Problem Four: Maybe I should just give up!

[P9] Big-Head Fish frowned, swimming forward along the long hallway.

[P10] It peeked through the door of another classroom,
cautiously looking inside.

[P11] This class is practicing drawing shapes,
most students can draw them.

[P12] Big-Head Fish tried to draw a diamond...
But he just couldn't do it.

[P13] The big-headed fish felt like a mess. He furrowed his brow, puffed out his cheeks with a 'puff-puff' sound, and 'clunk' dropped his pencil, counting up the troubles he had encountered:

[P14] Problem One: I'm not smart!
Problem Two: I'll never learn it!
And Problem Four: Maybe I should just give up!
Problem Three: I can't adapt!

[P15] Swimming Team
Sign up now!
Become a diving star!
Big-Head Fish looked worried,
floating lower and lower down the hallway.
Boys
Girls

[P16] Until she arrived again at the door of a classroom—
perhaps this was the place he was meant to be.

[P17] This class is practicing arithmetic, and most students can do it.

[P18] Big-Head Fish tried to write out long division...
But he just couldn't do it.

[P19] Bighead Fish felt completely overwhelmed. He furrowed his brow, puffed out his cheeks with a 'puff-puff' sound, and 'clunk' dropped his pencil, counting up all the troubles he had encountered:

[P20] Trouble One: I'm not smart!
Trouble Two: I'll never learn it!
There's also the fourth...
Trouble Three: I can't adapt!

[P21] "Forget it!"
He swam hurriedly out of school. "Oh, I've had enough! School is just self-inflicted suffering. I don't want to stay here!"

[P22] At this moment, a gentle and friendly voice came: 
"Don't worry! We haven't even started learning yet, and it's okay if you don't understand.
Your perfect class is waiting for you—
I'm Teacher Huit, and I'm here to help you learn. I know you can do it!"

[P23] "You are a smart little fish. With lots of practice, you'll learn. Little one, you'll adapt here—be sure to remember!"

[P24] Big-Head Fish followed Mr. Huit, swimming swiftly forward with splashes around them. They swam to a door with a sign, which read "New Student Class".

[P25] Teacher Hewitt greets everyone: "Good morning! So glad to see you all here. We’re going to have a year full of anticipation together!
Truth One: You are smart.
Truth Two: You can learn!
Truth Three: You are together.
And Truth Four: Remember this!"

[P26] Class has started, and Teacher Hewitt is leading everyone in learning.
Students, listen first, then try to do it...
Every student is doing a great job!

[P27] Bighead Fish smiled. "Goodbye, sad face! No more little worries of being suspicious! No more terrible big troubles!"

[P28] Bighead Fish swims happily with his friends, with Teacher Hewitt by his side. Students and teacher together, full of confidence, cheer proudly:

[P29] Truth One: We are smart.
Truth Two: We can learn.
Truth Three: We are together.

[P30] "We will definitely remember!"
Preschool Class Party
Ms. Hewitt's Class
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《大头鱼上学记》的封面，展示了主角大头鱼戴着绿色书包、表情略显紧张的形象，下方是海底的沙地和小生物，标明了作者、绘者和译者信息。
[P2] 本页讲述了大头鱼第一次上学的情景：他带着父母的祝福和期待冲进学校，但很快便迷路了。画面中，大头鱼被父母送至标有“深海摇摆鱼小学”的校门前，周围有许多其他小鱼和海洋生物。
[P3] 画面展示了大头鱼进入学校后，周围其他大鱼们迅速找到储物柜和班级，飞快地游进教室，而大头鱼则显得迷茫无助。
[P4] 大头鱼因迷路而落在后面，笑容消失，最终停在一间教室门口，羞怯地向内张望。
[P5] 画面展示了一间教室，学生们正在练习书写，老师在黑板前指导，墙上挂着学生作品，大头鱼从门缝中偷偷张望，显得有些紧张和不安。
[P6] 大头鱼在教室里尝试书写自己的名字，但屡次失败，显得沮丧和无助。
[P7] 大头鱼因无法写好自己的名字而感到沮丧，他皱眉、叹气并扔下铅笔，开始数自己遇到的麻烦。
[P8] 大头鱼在尝试书写时感到沮丧，他列举了自己遇到的四个心理困扰：觉得自己不聪明、永远学不会、无法适应新环境，以及想要放弃。画面中他藏在四个大字母里，表现出内心的焦虑和自我怀疑。
[P9] 大头鱼独自一人在学校的长廊中迷茫地前行，眉头紧锁，显得困惑和不安。
[P10] 大头鱼透过另一间教室的门，小心翼翼地向里面张望，表情紧张，似乎在观察或犹豫是否进入。
[P11] 画面展示了一间教室，学生们正在练习画形状，大多数同学都能完成，气氛轻松愉快。
[P12] 大头鱼尝试画菱形，但屡次失败，显得沮丧和无助。
[P13] 大头鱼因无法画好菱形而感到沮丧，他皱眉、叹气并扔下铅笔，开始数自己遇到的麻烦。
[P14] 大头鱼在四个几何图形中分别表达了自己的四个心理困扰：觉得自己不聪明、永远学不会、无法适应新环境，以及想要放弃，表现出强烈的自我怀疑和沮丧情绪。
[P15] 大头鱼神情沮丧地飘过学校走廊，路过游泳队海报和男女卫生间，显得心情低落。
[P16] 大头鱼站在一间教室门前，神情犹豫，似乎在思考是否进入，内心充满不确定与期待。
[P17] 画面展示了一间教室，学生们正在练习算术，气氛轻松，大多数同学都能完成，而大头鱼从门外窥视，表情紧张，似乎在犹豫是否进入。
[P18] 大头鱼尝试列竖式计算除法，但屡次失败，显得困惑和沮丧。
[P19] 大头鱼因学习困难感到沮丧，他皱眉、叹气并扔下铅笔，准备数自己遇到的麻烦。
[P20] 大头鱼在四个几何图形中分别表达了自己的四个心理困扰：觉得自己不聪明、永远学不会、无法适应新环境，以及暗示还有第四个麻烦，表现出强烈的自我怀疑和沮丧情绪。
[P21] 大头鱼决定放弃，他游离学校，内心充满对上学的厌倦和抗拒，表达了想要逃离的强烈情绪。
[P22] 大头鱼正感到沮丧时，一位名叫休伊特的老师出现，用温柔友善的声音鼓励他，表示会帮助他学习，并相信他能行。
[P23] 休伊特老师温柔地鼓励大头鱼，肯定他的聪明才智，并告诉他通过练习就能学会，会适应新环境，给予他信心和希望。
[P24] 大头鱼在休伊特老师的带领下游向标有“新生班”的教室门口，画面充满希望与新开始的氛围。
[P25] 休伊特老师在教室里向学生们打招呼，用四条积极的‘真相’鼓励他们，强调他们的聪明、学习能力、团结以及要记住这些信念，营造出充满希望和积极氛围的开学场景。
[P26] 休伊特老师带领学生们开始上课，鼓励他们先听再尝试，画面中所有学生都在认真完成任务，表现出积极的学习氛围。
[P27] 大头鱼露出笑容，告别了之前的沮丧情绪，并展示了一幅画，画中是自己曾经悲伤的样子，象征着内心的转变和积极的开始。
[P28] 大头鱼和同学们在休伊特老师的陪伴下一起畅游，大家充满信心，自豪地欢呼，展现出积极向上的集体氛围。
[P29] 画面中，休伊特老师和学生们聚集在教室里，老师向学生们展示三条积极的‘真相’，强调他们的聪明、学习能力和团结，营造出充满希望和鼓励的氛围。
[P30] 画面展示了一场学前班联欢会，学生们在装饰有气球和横幅的海底场景中欢聚，大头鱼和其他同学一起庆祝，气氛欢乐，横幅上写着“学前班联欢会”，下方标有“休伊特老师班级”，体现了班级的团结与积极氛围。
